subject: Problem when publishing: "Account" and "Application" are blank

messages.author: 38be8712ab4740a7
messages.subject: Problem when publishing: "Account" and "Application" are blank
parts:
Hi All,

I'm trying deploy an app and when I click publish, the "Account:" drop down menu reads "[object Object]" and "Application:" drop down reads "Create New" without any other options. I've recently gone through updating R and reinstalling all the old packages (this app was originally written and functional in May). I've tried new tokens, but nothing I've tried seems to help. 

Any ideas on how I can get this App up and running online?

Thanks!
Colby

messages.author: 5893d17d64b5b0c2
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problem when publishing: "Account" and "Application" are blank
parts:
Hi Colby,

This error usually results from including Shiny content in your document, but not marking the document itself as Shiny. Can you try a few things?

1. Add "runtime: shiny" to your YAML header. For instance:

---
title: "My document"
author: "Me"
runtime: shiny
---

shinyapps.io is designed to host Shiny content (you can use RPubs if you're just publishing non-interactive R Markdown docs). 

2. Can you paste the relevant portion of the doc (around the line number associated with the error, if any)? 

Jonathan.
